data.text: My family’s living has always depended on this lake, and the clinic looks after those same families. I’m willing to pledge 12.5 tons’ worth directly to the clinic once we confirm its request, provided our combined catch stays within 50 tons. Luke, could you put us in touch with the clinic so we can verify the deadline and ask about covering the gap? If there’s genuinely no other way to keep treatment going today, I’d consider 15 tons with the recovery plan agreed by all five of us. Jack, would you support that approach?
